label: Live
purpose: Public development deployment on Stellar Testnet. Not a production deployment.

source.note: The commit the WASM was built from, as stated by whoever ran the deployment. `verify` compares the network with a local build.

timesNote: uploadedAt and deployedAt are the close times of the upload and creation transactions, as reported by the network. runStartedAt is when the script began.

deployer.note: A throwaway Testnet account. Its secret key was never printed or saved and has been discarded. The contract has no administrator, owner or upgrade path, so nothing depends on this account.

check: get(1) returned PolicyNotFound, as expected for a contract with no policies
